package.name: ipa_building_navigation
package.description: A* path planning and TSP solvers for building navigation. ROS2 port (rena-patches): only the TSP-solver library (A*, nearest-neighbor, genetic) needed by the coverage planner is carried over. The Concorde solver (external binary), the clique/set-cover/ trolley library, the action servers and dynamic_reconfigure are dropped.
